name: binaryllm
description: Rethinking LLMs from the bit up: binary representations, deterministic tokenization, local learning rules. Targets CPU and WebAssembly, not datacenter GPUs.

scripts.docs: npx documentation build src/**/*.js -f html -o docs
scripts.docs:watch: npx documentation build src/**/*.js -f html -o docs --watch
scripts.lintdiff: git diff --name-only --cached --relative | grep '\.js$' | xargs standard | snazzy
scripts.update: npx npm-check-updates -u; npm update; npm install

author: William Brendel
